- Major rewrite introducing a comprehensive, detailed skill contract and usage guide for category-narrative-mapper.

- Adds explicit guidance on competitive messaging drift analysis, supporting both real-time and archival comparisons.
- Strengthens compliance (data handling, security, and output format) and directs handoffs clearly to follow-up skills.
